title: Mobile World Congress
metaDescription: Mobile World Congress: verified dates, venue and practical planning context for this technology event.

overview.about: Mobile World Congress (MWC) in Barcelona is the biggest event in the mobile and telecommunications industry, drawing carriers, device makers and chip firms from around the world. Held each spring, it is the stage for new phones, network technology and the industry's biggest deals.
overview.nextEvent: The next Mobile World Congress is held in Barcelona at the Fira Gran Via. Organised by the GSMA, it pairs a vast exhibition with a high-level conference on connectivity, 5G/6G, AI and the future of mobile.

@graph.name: Mobile World Congress
@graph.description: MWC Barcelona is GSMA’s annual gathering for the mobile and connectivity industry, based at Fira Gran Via in L’Hospitalet de Llobregat beside Barcelona. Network operators, device makers and software companies use the event for product demonstrations, meetings and conference sessions. The 2027 programme is scheduled for four March days; Fira Gran Via is reached by metro and rail rather than being in Barcelona’s historic centre.

arrivalWindow: Arrive before 1 March if you need local check-in or opening-day access.
eventDayDetail: Mobile World Congress is dated 1 March 2027 – 4 March 2027; use that range when planning arrival, tickets and reminders.
airport: Barcelona–El Prat Airport. For Mobile World Congress, allow extra time for venue transfers on event days.
airportTransfer: From Barcelona–El Prat Airport, follow the airport operator's rail, bus or taxi information to reach Fira Gran Via in Barcelona.
stayGuidance: For Mobile World Congress, book near a rail, metro or tram stop and confirm the final venue address before arrival.
transportTip: Metro, train and Aerobús connections serve Barcelona event districts.
transportDetail: Check the official transport guidance for Barcelona and the organiser's event-day instructions for Mobile World Congress; venue entry times can change road access.
eventDayTip: On Mobile World Congress days, carry the ticket or accreditation required by the organiser and arrive before the published entry window at Fira Gran Via.
